Method of Attack: MortalKombat ransomware variant of Xorist used to extort victims by encrypting files and demanding ransom payment in Bitcoin via qTOX Tor-based instant messaging app; corrupts system folders, disables Windows Run command, removes startup entries, and modifies Windows registry for persistence
Laplas clipper malware that hijacks cryptocurrency transactions by monitoring Windows clipboard for crypto addresses and substituting them with attacker-controlled addresses
Impacted Systems: Windows systems including system files, applications, databases, backups, virtual machine files, and remote mapped logical drives
Attack Vector: Phishing emails containing malicious ZIP attachments with BAT loader scripts that download and execute malware payloads
